items.title_es: How the Clarity Act's Defeat Handed the SEC and CFTC the Wheel on Crypto

items.title: Bitcoin's Sharpest Rally in Two Years Ran Almost Entirely on Short Liquidations
items.summary: A Glassnode and Bybit report found Bitcoin climbed 24.6% in five August days even as active leverage fell, with short positions supplying 89% of every liquidated dollar.
items.title_es: Bitcoin's Sharpest Rally in Two Years Ran Almost Entirely on Short Liquidations

items.summary: Though the Crossmint-powered memecoin sales are still live on both apps, Visa's grace period is expected to end next week, per the report.

items.title: Grayscale Is Making Its Red-Hot Zcash ETF More Affordable
